compute.reported_as: For all the system's sizes we use the same number of the training epochs (1500) and the same ViT architecture that comprises 4 layers, 12 attention heads and embedding dimension of 60, which results in ∼1.5×10^5 trainable parameters. To update the network parameters we use stochastic reconfiguration approach [21] with the built-in MetropolisExchange sampling method. The corresponding number of samples is 4096.
